home: A cottage on the outskirts of Nebruz, closer to the swamp than the boardwalks
appearance: Seemingly human female, late twenties in appearance; fae blood means she is considerably older than she looks
and_yet: Most of her charms and love potions are effective placebos. Her healing is entirely real.
wants: Village health; the balance between Nebruz and the swamp tribes maintained; her friendship with Leeandra undisturbed
does_not_want: Conflict between Nebruz and the swamp tribes; the temple reopened
pc_leverage: Respect the swamp; she is the informal channel to Leeandra for those Leeandra has not yet agreed to meet
